brief: Athanasius was born about 296 and became patriarch of Alexandria in 328. Although exiled four times by the efforts of his opponents, he did much to foster the eventual triumph of the doctrine affirmed at the Council of Nicea that Christ is “of one being with the Father”, rather than a more qualified statement of Christ’s divinity. His treatise, On the Incarnation of the Word of God, is still a widely read classic, and his Life of Antony did much to popularise a monastic life-style. He died in 373.
